reasons: No automated check or screenshot test is visible for the styles.
A few button rules are duplicated, which can confuse later changes.
The page has not been checked in a browser as part of this review.

terms.meaning: the style language that controls how a web page looks
the part of a style rule that names which elements it applies to
a layout method that arranges items in a row or column and spaces them
a layout method that arranges items into rows and columns
a rule that applies only when the screen is a certain width

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Reset of spacing and sizing
sections.what: Removes default margins and padding and makes every box include its border in its size.
sections.why: Gives every browser the same starting point so layouts line up.
sections.watch_out: Every element is affected, so added spacing elsewhere may look different than expected.

sections.name: body
sections.title: Page background and text
sections.what: Sets a purple gradient background that fills the screen, the default font, and dark gray text.
sections.why: Likely reason: sets the brand look for the whole page.

sections.name: .main-container
sections.title: Centered main container
sections.what: Limits the page content to a maximum width of 1400 pixels and centers it.
sections.why: Keeps content readable on wide monitors.

sections.name: .app-header
sections.title: Header card style
sections.what: Makes the top header a white rounded card with padding and a soft shadow.
sections.why: Likely reason: separates the title area from the content.

sections.name: .header-content h1
sections.title: Gradient header title
sections.what: Fills the main heading with a purple gradient instead of a solid color.
sections.why: Visual emphasis for the app name.
sections.watch_out: Relies on browser-specific text rules, so some browsers may show the heading in a plain color.

sections.name: .subtitle
sections.title: Subtitle style
sections.what: Styles the line under the title in gray with a larger font.
sections.why: Likely reason: a secondary description under the heading.

sections.name: .header-status
sections.title: Header status row layout
sections.what: Places the API label and status badge side by side with a small gap.
sections.why: Keeps the status label on one line.

sections.name: .status-badge
sections.title: Status badge shape
sections.what: Gives the API status badge rounded ends, bold text, and padding.
sections.why: Makes the status easy to notice.

sections.name: .status-online
sections.title: Online status colors
sections.what: Shows the online badge with a light green background and dark green text.
sections.why: Green signals the backend is reachable.
sections.watch_out: The script must add this class; the color does not change by itself.

sections.name: .status-offline
sections.title: Offline status colors
sections.what: Shows the offline badge with a light red background and dark red text.
sections.why: Red signals the backend cannot be reached.
sections.watch_out: Like the online style, it only appears if the script adds this class.

sections.name: .progress-stepper
sections.title: Progress bar card layout
sections.what: Makes the six-step progress bar a white card with items spread across the full width.
sections.why: Shows the whole journey at once.

sections.name: .step
sections.title: Single step layout
sections.what: Stacks each step's circle above its label and centers them.
sections.why: Keeps each step's number and name together.

sections.name: .step-number
sections.title: Step number circle
sections.what: Draws a gray circle of fixed size with a bold number and a short color transition.
sections.why: Makes each step look like a numbered button.

sections.name: .step.active .step-number
sections.title: Active step highlight
sections.what: Gives the current step a purple gradient, white number, slightly larger size, and a glow.
sections.why: Shows the user where they are.
sections.watch_out: Only one step should have the active class at a time.

sections.name: .step.completed .step-number
sections.title: Completed step color
sections.what: Turns finished steps green with white numbers.
sections.why: Shows progress already made.
sections.watch_out: The script must add the completed class to earlier steps.

sections.name: .step.completed .step-number::after
sections.title: Checkmark on completed step
sections.what: Adds a check mark symbol to finished step circles.
sections.why: Makes completion clear without relying only on color.
sections.watch_out: The check mark replaces the number visually, not in the page content.

sections.name: .step-label
sections.title: Step label text
sections.what: Styles the step names under the circles as small, centered, gray text.
sections.why: Keeps labels readable without crowding the bar.

sections.name: .step.active .step-label
sections.title: Active step label
sections.what: Makes the current step's name purple and bold.
sections.why: Matches the highlighted circle.

sections.name: .step-connector
sections.title: Line between steps
sections.what: Draws a thin gray line between step circles.
sections.why: Connects the steps visually as one path.
sections.watch_out: The top offset is fixed at 20 pixels, so changing the circle size may misalign the line.

sections.name: .step.completed + .step-connector
sections.title: Line after completed step
sections.what: Colors the line that follows a finished step green.
sections.why: Shows the path already completed.
sections.watch_out: Depends on the completed step being directly before its connector in the page structure.

sections.name: .content-wrapper
sections.title: Main content card
sections.what: Makes the content area a white rounded card with padding and a minimum height.
sections.why: Gives each step a consistent panel.

sections.name: .step-content
sections.title: Hidden step panels
sections.what: Hides every step panel by default.
sections.why: Only the current step should be visible.
sections.watch_out: A panel stays hidden unless the active class is added to it.

sections.name: .step-content.active
sections.title: Visible step with fade in
sections.what: Shows the active step panel and plays a short fade and slide-up animation.
sections.why: Softens the change between steps.

sections.name: .welcome-screen
sections.title: Welcome screen centering
sections.what: Centers the text on the welcome screen.
sections.why: Likely reason: matches the centered welcome design.

sections.name: .hero-section
sections.title: Hero section spacing
sections.what: Adds space below the welcome heading block.
sections.why: Separates the intro from the cards.

sections.name: .hero-section h2
sections.title: Hero heading
sections.what: Sets a large dark heading for the welcome message.
sections.why: Main message on the first screen.

sections.name: .hero-text
sections.title: Hero paragraph
sections.what: Styles the welcome text as larger gray text with a limited width and comfortable line spacing.
sections.why: Keeps the intro text easy to read.

sections.name: .journey-cards
sections.title: Journey card grid
sections.what: Arranges the six step cards in a grid that adds columns as space allows.
sections.why: Shows all steps in an easy-to-scan layout.

sections.name: .journey-card
sections.title: Journey card look
sections.what: Gives each step card a light gray background, rounded corners, padding, and a smooth transition.
sections.why: Makes each card look like a separate tile.

sections.name: .journey-card:hover
sections.title: Journey card hover lift
sections.what: Moves a card up slightly and adds a shadow when the mouse is over it.
sections.why: Signals that the card responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .card-icon
sections.title: Journey card icon size
sections.what: Makes the card emoji large.
sections.why: Gives each card a visual anchor.

sections.name: .journey-card h3
sections.title: Journey card heading
sections.what: Styles each card title in dark text with spacing below.
sections.why: Clear title for each card.

sections.name: .journey-card p
sections.title: Journey card text
sections.what: Styles each card description in smaller gray text with comfortable line height.
sections.why: Keeps descriptions secondary to titles.

sections.name: .features-section
sections.title: Features section spacing
sections.what: Adds space below the features block.
sections.why: Separates it from the start button.

sections.name: .features-section h3
sections.title: Features heading
sections.what: Styles the Platform Features heading.
sections.why: Labels the feature list.

sections.name: .features-grid
sections.title: Features grid
sections.what: Arranges feature tiles in a responsive grid.
sections.why: Fits as many tiles as the width allows.

sections.name: .feature
sections.title: Feature tile
sections.what: Gives each feature a purple gradient box with white bold text, aligned in a row.
sections.why: Highlights the platform's claims.
sections.watch_out: The feature text is fixed in the HTML and is not checked against real capabilities.

sections.name: .feature-icon
sections.title: Feature icon size
sections.what: Makes the feature emoji larger.
sections.why: Matches the tile style.

sections.name: .action-section
sections.title: Action section spacing
sections.what: Adds space above the start button area.
sections.why: Separates the call to action.

sections.name: .help-text
sections.title: Help text style
sections.what: Styles the help line under the start button in gray with space above.
sections.why: Keeps help text quiet.

sections.name: .help-text a
sections.title: Help link style
sections.what: Colors help links purple and bold without an underline.
sections.why: Makes links visible but understated.

sections.name: .help-text a:hover
sections.title: Help link hover underline
sections.what: Underlines help links when the mouse is over them.
sections.why: Confirms the link is clickable.

sections.name: .step-header
sections.title: Step header block
sections.what: Adds space below and a light gray line under each step's heading block.
sections.why: Separates the step title from the step content.

sections.name: .step-header h2
sections.title: Step header heading
sections.what: Sets large dark text for each step title.
sections.why: Names the current step.

sections.name: .step-header p
sections.title: Step header paragraph
sections.what: Styles the step description in larger gray text.
sections.why: Explains the step briefly.

sections.name: .form-group
sections.title: Form field spacing
sections.what: Adds space below each form group.
sections.why: Keeps fields from crowding each other.

sections.name: .form-row
sections.title: Two column form row
sections.what: Places form fields side by side and wraps them when the width is small.
sections.why: Saves space on wide screens.
sections.watch_out: Mobile rules later switch this to one column.

sections.name: label
sections.title: Label style and input base
sections.what: Makes labels bold and dark, and sets the shared look for text fields.
sections.why: Makes forms readable and consistent.
sections.watch_out: The selector list continues into the next section, so this rule is shared by several field types.

sections.name: select
sections.title: Dropdown style
sections.what: Makes dropdowns full width with a light border, rounded corners, and padding.
sections.why: Matches the text field look.

sections.name: select:focus
sections.title: Dropdown focus glow
sections.what: Shows a purple border and soft glow when a dropdown is selected.
sections.why: Shows which field has focus.
sections.watch_out: Removing the outline here is intentional, so the glow is the only focus signal.

sections.name: textarea
sections.title: Text area size
sections.what: Lets text areas resize vertically with a minimum height.
sections.why: Gives room for longer answers.

sections.name: .field-help
sections.title: Small help text under fields
sections.what: Styles the small hint text under a field in gray.
sections.why: Explains what to enter without cluttering the field.

sections.name: .file-upload-area
sections.title: File drop zone
sections.what: Draws a large dashed box with padding and a light background for file selection.
sections.why: Makes the upload area obvious.

sections.name: .file-upload-area:hover
sections.title: Drop zone hover
sections.what: Changes the drop zone border and background to purple tints on hover.
sections.why: Signals the area is clickable.

sections.name: .file-upload-area input[type="file"]
sections.title: Hidden file input over zone
sections.what: Makes the real file input invisible and stretches it over the whole zone so any click opens the file picker.
sections.why: Lets the whole box work as a button without showing the default control.
sections.watch_out: Depends on the zone having position set to relative in an earlier rule.

sections.name: .upload-placeholder
sections.title: Upload prompt passes clicks
sections.what: Stops the placeholder text from catching clicks so the hidden input receives them.
sections.why: Without this, clicks would land on the text instead of the file input.
sections.watch_out: If this rule is removed, clicking on the text will not open the file picker.

sections.name: .upload-icon
sections.title: Upload icon size
sections.what: Makes the upload icon large and on its own line.
sections.why: Draws attention to the drop zone.

sections.name: .upload-placeholder p
sections.title: Upload prompt text
sections.what: Styles the main upload instruction in dark, slightly larger text.
sections.why: Clear instruction.

sections.name: .upload-placeholder small
sections.title: Upload small text
sections.what: Styles the accepted file types note in gray.
sections.why: Shows allowed types without shouting.
sections.watch_out: Listed types here must match the accept setting in the HTML.

sections.name: .btn-link
sections.title: Shared button base
sections.what: Sets the common button look (padding, rounded corners, bold text, pointer cursor) for primary, secondary, and link buttons.
sections.why: The selector list in the file applies this to all three button styles.
sections.watch_out: Padding here is later overridden for link buttons, so changing this block may not change them.

sections.name: .btn-primary
sections.title: Primary button colors
sections.what: Gives primary buttons the purple gradient with white text.
sections.why: Marks the main action on each step.

sections.name: .btn-primary:hover
sections.title: Primary button hover lift
sections.what: Moves primary buttons up slightly with a glow on hover.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .btn-large
sections.title: Large button size
sections.what: Makes large buttons wider and taller.
sections.why: Emphasizes the start and validate actions.

sections.name: .btn-small
sections.title: Small button size
sections.what: Makes small buttons compact.
sections.why: Used for refresh and other secondary actions.

sections.name: .btn-secondary
sections.title: Secondary button colors
sections.what: Gives secondary buttons a gray background with white text.
sections.why: Marks back and other less important actions.

sections.name: .btn-secondary:hover
sections.title: Secondary button hover
sections.what: Darkens the gray background on hover.
sections.why: Confirms the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .btn-link
sections.title: Link-style button
sections.what: Makes these buttons transparent with purple text and smaller padding.
sections.why: Used for quiet actions such as skipping a step.
sections.watch_out: This rule overrides the padding and background from the shared button base, so the two rules must be read together.

sections.name: .btn-link:hover
sections.title: Link-style button hover
sections.what: Adds a light purple tint on hover.
sections.why: Shows the button responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .info-box
sections.title: Info box look
sections.what: Gives info boxes a pale blue background, a purple left border, padding, and rounded corners.
sections.why: Highlights tips and explanations.

sections.name: .info-box strong
sections.title: Info box heading
sections.what: Makes the bold line inside an info box a block with spacing below.
sections.why: Separates the heading from the body.

sections.name: .info-box ul
sections.title: Info box list indent
sections.what: Indents lists inside info boxes and sets a gray text color.
sections.why: Makes lists readable inside the box.

sections.name: .info-box li
sections.title: Info box list spacing
sections.what: Adds a little space between list items in info boxes.
sections.why: Keeps list items from crowding.

sections.name: .result-box
sections.title: Result panel box
sections.what: Gives result panels a light gray background, rounded corners, and space above.
sections.why: Separates results from the form.

sections.name: .result-box h3
sections.title: Result panel heading
sections.what: Sets the result heading in dark text with space below.
sections.why: Labels the results.

sections.name: .result-actions
sections.title: Result action buttons row
sections.what: Places result buttons in a wrapping row with gaps.
sections.why: Keeps buttons visible on narrow screens.

sections.name: .question-card
sections.title: Question card look
sections.what: Gives each question a white card with a light border, rounded corners, and padding.
sections.why: Makes each question stand out during review.

sections.name: .question-card:hover
sections.title: Question card hover
sections.what: Turns the card border purple and adds a shadow on hover.
sections.why: Shows the card is interactive.

sections.name: .question-meta
sections.title: Question tag row
sections.what: Places the type and category tags in a wrapping row with space above.
sections.why: Keeps tags tidy under the question text.

sections.name: .badge
sections.title: Tag shape
sections.what: Gives tags padding, rounded corners, and bold small text.
sections.why: Makes tags easy to scan.

sections.name: .badge-type
sections.title: Type tag colors
sections.what: Gives type tags a solid purple background with white text.
sections.why: Distinguishes question types.

sections.name: .badge-category
sections.title: Category tag colors
sections.what: Gives category tags a pale purple background with purple text.
sections.why: Distinguishes categories from types.

sections.name: .documents-section
sections.title: Documents section divider
sections.what: Adds space and a light line above the uploaded documents list.
sections.why: Separates the list from the upload form.

sections.name: .section-header
sections.title: Section title row
sections.what: Places a section title and a refresh button on one line with space between them.
sections.why: Keeps the refresh action near the list heading.

sections.name: .section-header h3
sections.title: Section title text
sections.what: Sets the section title in dark text.
sections.why: Labels the list.

sections.name: .placeholder-text
sections.title: Placeholder text
sections.what: Centers gray italic text with padding.
sections.why: Shows empty-state messages such as no documents yet.

sections.name: .export-options
sections.title: Export card grid
sections.what: Arranges export cards in a responsive grid.
sections.why: Shows JSON, CSV, and Markdown options together.

sections.name: .export-card
sections.title: Export card look
sections.what: Gives export cards a light gray background, rounded corners, padding, and centered text.
sections.why: Makes each option a clear tile.

sections.name: .export-card:hover
sections.title: Export card hover lift
sections.what: Moves export cards up with a shadow on hover.
sections.why: Shows the card responds to the mouse.

sections.name: .export-card h3
sections.title: Export card heading
sections.what: Sets the export card title in dark text.
sections.why: Names the format.

sections.name: .export-card p
sections.title: Export card text
sections.what: Styles the export description in gray with space below.
sections.why: Explains the format.

sections.name: .success-section
sections.title: Success section spacing
sections.what: Adds space above the completion message.
sections.why: Separates it from the export cards.

sections.name: .success-message
sections.title: Success banner
sections.what: Gives the completion message a green gradient, white text, rounded corners, and centered padding.
sections.why: Celebrates the finished survey.

sections.name: .success-icon
sections.title: Success icon size
sections.what: Makes the success emoji very large and on its own line.
sections.why: Visual celebration.

sections.name: .success-message h3
sections.title: Success heading
sections.what: Makes the success heading large and adds space below.
sections.why: Main completion message.

sections.name: .success-message p
sections.title: Success paragraph
sections.what: Styles the success text larger with space below.
sections.why: Readable completion text.

sections.name: .success-message ul
sections.title: Success list without bullets
sections.what: Removes bullet points from the next-steps list.
sections.why: Lets the custom check marks take their place.

sections.name: .success-message li
sections.title: Success list item spacing
sections.what: Adds vertical space between next-steps items.
sections.why: Keeps the list easy to read.

sections.name: .success-message li::before
sections.title: Success check symbol
sections.what: Adds a bold check mark before each next-steps item.
sections.why: Makes each item look completed.

sections.name: .step-actions

sections.why: Keeps navigation consistent on every step.

sections.name: .loading-overlay

sections.name: .spinner
sections.title: Spinner and animation

sections.name: .loading-overlay p
sections.title: Loading text

sections.why: Tells the user what is happening.

sections.name: .error-message

sections.what: Gives error messages a pink background, red left border, and dark red text.

sections.name: .success-item
sections.title: Success item box
sections.what: Gives success messages a green background, green left border, and dark green text.
sections.why: Confirms a good result.

sections.name: .placeholder-box
sections.title: Placeholder box
sections.what: Gives empty areas a dashed gray border and centered large text.

sections.name: @media (max-width: 768px)
sections.title: Mobile layout rules
sections.what: Below 768 pixels wide, reduces padding and switches grids to one column. Stacks step buttons and makes them full width.
sections.why: Makes the wizard usable on phones.
sections.watch_out: Changes to the desktop grids must be checked here too, or narrow screens may break.

summary: The stylesheet that gives the wizard page its colors, layout, buttons, cards, and mobile behavior.
purpose: Makes the setup wizard look consistent and guides the user through six steps with a visible progress bar.
why: Keeps all visual rules in one file, separate from the page structure and behavior.
how: The page loads this file. Rules first reset spacing, then style the header, progress bar, step panels, forms, buttons, result panels, and overlays, and finally adjust the layout for narrow screens.
inputs: Class names and element types set in wizard.html, plus classes added by wizard-app.js such as active, completed, and error-message.
outputs: Colors, sizes, spacing, animations, and layout on the page. Produces no data.
risks: Some button rules are repeated, so a later rule can quietly override an earlier one. Visual changes are not checked by any automated test visible here.
debug: Use the browser developer tools to find the element, then check which rule wins for the property that looks wrong. Look at the .btn-link rules and the step classes first.
